facts.text: New VMI cadets enter the Corps through an intensive orientation termed the Rat Line before earning fourth-class cadet rank after Breakout.

sources.title: Class System - Virginia Military Institute
sources.quote: New cadets begin as “rats”, entering the Corps through an intense orientation called the Rat Line — a period focused on discipline, resilience, teamwork, and personal growth. Once “rats” complete Breakout, they become the 4th Class.
